answer_1.quote: In this paper, we aim to generate a large-scale multi-skill dialogue dataset without additional costs or human efforts. To this end, we introduce an automatic data curation approach named BOTSTALK, where multiple dialogue agents grounded to individual skills engage in the conversation to blend all skills together.
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn dialogues with blended conversational skills

answer_2.quote: For the retrieval task, we report recall@k (R@k), where each test example has 100 possible candidates to select from, as well as mean reciprocal rank (MRR). For the generative task, we compute the average score of BLEU-1, -2, -3, -4 (Avg. BLEU).

answer_4.quote: To assess the quality of BSBT dataset, we perform human evaluation by employing ACUTE-Eval , a popular metric for multi-turn dialogue evaluation . We randomly sample 100 dialogues from the BST and BSBT datasets respectively, and then ask human evaluators to compare each pair of dialogues over three axes: engagingness, interestingness and humanness.
answer_4.guideline: • Engagingness: Who would you prefer to talk to? Which version is more likely to hold your attention and make you want to hear more? • Interestingness: Who would you say is more interesting? Which version arouses your curiosity or tells you something new or useful? • Humanness: Who would you say sounds more human? Which version is more natural and personable?
